ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BYANDBETWEEN FIFTH 47 LLC AND 2-8 WEST 47TH OWNER LLC Dated: as of November 1, 2009 BLOCK:1262 LOT: 42 RECORDANDRETURNTO: KRAMERLEVINNAFTALISANDFRANKELLLP 1177AVENUEOFTHEAMERICAS NEW YORK, NEW YORK 10036 ATTENTION:PAULD.SELVER,ESQ. KL3 2698475.9

ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT day of November, 2009 by and between FIFTH 47 LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Owner"), having an address at c/o ABS Partners Real Estate, LLC, 200 Park Avenue South, New York, NY 10003 and 2-8 WEST 47TH OWNER LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("Developer"), having an address at c/o Extell Development Company, 805 Third Ave., Seventh Floor,NewYork,NY10022. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 2-8 West 47th Street, New York, New York, designated as Tax Lot 42 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map of the City of New York (the“Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the "Owner Fee Parcel"); WHEREAS,the Owner Fee Parcel is in the process of being subdivided to create the Owner Land (as hereinafter defined) and the Airspace Premises (as hereinafter defined) (the “Tax Lot Subdivision"); WHEREAS,Owner intends to retain the portion of the Owner Fee Parcel which liesbelow a horizontal plane(the“Lower Limiting Plane") drawn at an elevation of 810.88feet above Datum Level (as hereinafter defined) and more particularly described on Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the buildings and improvements thereon (said portion of the Owner Fee Parcel located below the Lower Limiting Plane being herein replacement or vertical enlargement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement being herein called the“Owner Building,” and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"); WHEREAS, Developer will acquire from Owner by deed (the “Airspace Deed"), to be recorded in connection with this Agreement,the volume of air which lies above the Owner Land (as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, being herein called the “Airspace Premises"), so that Owner shall be the owner in fee of the Owner Premises and Developer shall be the owner in fee of the Airspace Premises; together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to this Agreement being called the “Developer Building") (the Developer Land, the Developer Building, the Development Site (as hereinafter defined), and the New Developer Building (as hereinafter defined) collectively, the “Developer Premises"),and/or (i) Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined), and (B) to merge the Combined Zoning Lot with the Developer Premises and/or the Additional Parcels to createanenlargedCombinedZoningLot;
